optimizeWorkspace.title: Optimize
optimizeWorkspace.description: Turn comparison findings into better listings. Review the facts before publishing.

queue.title: Your next listing changes
queue.description: Start with the lowest simulated win rates. Open a product to inspect the evidence.
queue.sample: This queue uses saved diagnostic suggestions. Check Data quality for the full active-catalog audit.
queue.count: {count, plural, one {# product shown} other {# products shown}}

method.title: How this queue works
method.description: Candidates have a recorded win rate below 55%. Dismissed products and listings published within the last 14 days are excluded from publishing candidates. A candidate is not a saved draft. Generate & publish creates new copy and immediately replaces the store listing. These suggestions do not predict sales or future win rates.

empty.title: Nothing waiting for review
empty.description: No listing suggestions are available for this store. Check product data or run a comparison to find the next improvement.

filtered.title: No matching products
filtered.description: Try a different product name or SKU.

error.title: The queue could not be loaded
error.description: Your product data is still saved. Try loading the queue again.

confirmation.title: Publish a new listing?
confirmation.description: Generate a new title and description for {title}, then publish them to your connected store. This replaces the current listing without a separate draft review.
confirmation.bulkDescription: Generate and publish new titles and descriptions for {count, plural, one {# eligible product} other {# eligible products}} in this store. Existing listings will be replaced.
confirmation.storeDescription: Write product structured data and, for Shopify, a store profile. Generate and publish copy for eligible products in this store. This can make several live changes.

toast.failed: The change could not be completed
toast.failedDescription: Please try again. If publishing started, check the product before retrying.
toast.published: {count, plural, one {# listing published} other {# listings published}}
toast.partial: {published} published; {failed} could not be completed. Review the remaining products before trying again.

history.unmeasured: A new comparison is needed to measure the result.

diagnostics.contentHint: Review the saved title and description. Include accurate specifications and relevant use cases.
diagnostics.structured_dataHint: Check the product’s structured data and add only verified attributes.
diagnostics.seoHint: Add a real product image at the source, then sync the catalog.
diagnostics.platformHint: This catalog cannot publish listing changes directly. Connect Shopify or WooCommerce, or update the source manually.
